hooks.command: BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown'); echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\": {\"hookEventName\": \"SessionStart\", \"additionalContext\": \"Current branch: '$BRANCH'. Before starting any task, read CLAUDE.md and then docs/workflow/INDEX.md. The workflow zone owns hard rules, task playbooks, and the post-change checklist.\"}}"

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -q 'git commit' && printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qe '--no-verify'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Hard rule: git commit --no-verify запрещён — pre-commit (lint-staged) должен выполняться."}}'; fi
hooks.statusMessage: Checking git command against hard rules...

hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // ""'); case "$f" in *"/src/"*.ts) cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && npx eslint --fix "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;; esac

input=$(cat); [ "$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false')" = "true" ] && exit 0; cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | grep -q '\.ts$' || exit 0; out=$(npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.build.json 2>&1) || { echo 'TypeScript check failed (Stop hook):' >&2; echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; }
